svg.title: One Pod, Two Separately Authorized Revenue Lanes
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-01-two-ledger-operating-workflow; chart type: process_flow; title: One Pod, Two Separately Authorized Revenue Lanes; subtitle: Keep regulated-market analytics distinct from state-licensed gaming acquisition.; chapter number: 1; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: The terminal is non-custodial and does not pool capital, accept customer funds, or submit customer orders. Analytics publishing does not itself establish an exemption from CTA, IB, or FCM requirements. Partner access and compensation require documented permission for the actual activity and jurisdiction.; caption: Build the permission map before the feed adapter; reconcile subscriptions and gaming commissions through different revenue accounts.; stages: label: Classify each activity; value: Two distinct permission records; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Inventory subscription analytics, personalization, solicitation, builder compensation, and gaming links. Apply 7 U.S.C. 1a and 6d to the derivatives lane and the applicable state vendor rules to the gaming lane; non-custody is necessary but does not resolve every registration question.; label: Normalize permitted feeds; value: Timestamp every market observation; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Use documented Kalshi, ForecastEx-access, and licensed sportsbook interfaces only where available and permitted. Record source time, receipt time, fees, contract wording, settlement terms, and market identifiers. Measure sub-second delivery as a service target rather than assuming every source provides a WebSocket feed.; label: Publish bounded analytics; value: Subscriptions without order handling; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Normalize implied probabilities and display fee-aware comparisons with stale-feed cutoffs. Label positive expected value as model-dependent, not riskless arbitrage; incompatible settlement terms and execution slippage can reverse the apparent edge. Do not add personalized recommendations without reassessing activity classification.; label: Attribute eligible referrals; value: Separate state and partner identifiers; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Apply the product's 21+ policy, jurisdiction-specific geofencing, partner allowlists, material-connection disclosures, and current responsible-gaming helpline disclosures. Sign server-to-server events, deduplicate event identifiers, and rely on partner confirmation for qualifying deposits rather than browser clicks.; label: Reconcile earned revenue; value: Separate subscriptions, rebates, CPA, and NGR; numeric value: 5.0; detail: Match SaaS invoices, expressly permitted builder statements, accepted CPA events, and settled NGR reports to bank receipts and receivables. Never book trading volume, gambling handle, player deposits, or user balances as operator revenue. Block unlicensed offshore, unlawful crypto, and unlawful sweepstakes destinations.

text.title: One Pod, Two Separately Authorized Revenue Lanes
text.tspan: One Pod, Two Separately Authorized Revenue Lanes

rect.title: label: Classify each activity; value: Two distinct permission records; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Inventory subscription analytics, personalization, solicitation, builder compensation, and gaming links. Apply 7 U.S.C. 1a and 6d to the derivatives lane and the applicable state vendor rules to the gaming lane; non-custody is necessary but does not resolve every registration question.

text.title: Inventory subscription analytics, personalization, solicitation, builder compensation, and gaming links. Apply 7 U.S.C. 1a and 6d to the derivatives lane and the applicable state vendor rules to the gaming lane; non-custody is necessary but does not resolve every registration question.

rect.title: label: Normalize permitted feeds; value: Timestamp every market observation; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Use documented Kalshi, ForecastEx-access, and licensed sportsbook interfaces only where available and permitted. Record source time, receipt time, fees, contract wording, settlement terms, and market identifiers. Measure sub-second delivery as a service target rather than assuming every source provides a WebSocket feed.

text.title: Use documented Kalshi, ForecastEx-access, and licensed sportsbook interfaces only where available and permitted. Record source time, receipt time, fees, contract wording, settlement terms, and market identifiers. Measure sub-second delivery as a service target rather than assuming every source provides a WebSocket feed.

rect.title: label: Publish bounded analytics; value: Subscriptions without order handling; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Normalize implied probabilities and display fee-aware comparisons with stale-feed cutoffs. Label positive expected value as model-dependent, not riskless arbitrage; incompatible settlement terms and execution slippage can reverse the apparent edge. Do not add personalized recommendations without reassessing activity classification.

text.title: Normalize implied probabilities and display fee-aware comparisons with stale-feed cutoffs. Label positive expected value as model-dependent, not riskless arbitrage; incompatible settlement terms and execution slippage can reverse the apparent edge. Do not add personalized recommendations without reassessing activity classification.

rect.title: label: Attribute eligible referrals; value: Separate state and partner identifiers; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Apply the product's 21+ policy, jurisdiction-specific geofencing, partner allowlists, material-connection disclosures, and current responsible-gaming helpline disclosures. Sign server-to-server events, deduplicate event identifiers, and rely on partner confirmation for qualifying deposits rather than browser clicks.

text.title: Apply the product's 21+ policy, jurisdiction-specific geofencing, partner allowlists, material-connection disclosures, and current responsible-gaming helpline disclosures. Sign server-to-server events, deduplicate event identifiers, and rely on partner confirmation for qualifying deposits rather than browser clicks.

rect.title: label: Reconcile earned revenue; value: Separate subscriptions, rebates, CPA, and NGR; numeric value: 5.0; detail: Match SaaS invoices, expressly permitted builder statements, accepted CPA events, and settled NGR reports to bank receipts and receivables. Never book trading volume, gambling handle, player deposits, or user balances as operator revenue. Block unlicensed offshore, unlawful crypto, and unlawful sweepstakes destinations.

text.title: Match SaaS invoices, expressly permitted builder statements, accepted CPA events, and settled NGR reports to bank receipts and receivables. Never book trading volume, gambling handle, player deposits, or user balances as operator revenue. Block unlicensed offshore, unlawful crypto, and unlawful sweepstakes destinations.

Assumptions: The terminal is non-custodial and does not pool capital, accept customer funds, or submit customer orders. Analytics publishing does not itself establish an exemption from CTA, IB, or FCM requirements. Partner access and compensation require documented permission for the actual activity and jurisdiction.
